text:
Residents:
Priya (50s, office). Weekdays: Out 08:00–17:30. Home evenings. Weekends: Sleeps in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: movies, reading.
Dana (30s, afternoon/night shift). Weekdays: Home mornings. Out 13:40–23:00. Weekends: Off work. Errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: baking, gaming, movies, yoga.
Hana (30s, office). Weekdays: Out 08:00–17:30. Home evenings. Weekends: Sleeps in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: board games, napping, reading.

Object Locations & Movement:
Items move based on resident schedules. Phones and personal items (keys, wallets, bags, shoes, jackets) are carried out by residents during work hours and returned in the evening.

Bathroom:
- Shelf: detergent_shared, laundry_basket_shared, skincare_hana, toiletry_bag_dana, toiletry_bag_priya.
- Med Cabinet: first_aid_kit_shared, medication_dana, medication_priya.
- Sink: razor_priya, soap_dispenser_shared, toothbrush_holder_shared.
- Towel Rack: towel_dana, towel_hana, towel_priya.

Bedroom 1:
- Floor: ironing_board_shared.
- Nightstand: phone_priya (evenings).
- All other spots empty.

Bedroom 2 (Dana’s room):
- Bed: tablet_dana (mornings).
- Desk: tablet_dana (afternoons/evenings), phone_dana (evenings).
- Nightstand: book_dana, glasses_dana.
- Wardrobe: yoga_mat_dana.
- All other spots empty.

Bedroom 3 (Hana’s room):
- Desk: charger_hana, laptop_hana, notebook_hana, pen_hana (evenings).
- Nightstand: phone_hana (evenings).
- All other spots empty.

Entry:
- Floor: toolbox_shared, umbrella_dana, umbrella_hana, umbrella_priya, vacuum_cleaner_shared.
- Hook: backpack_hana, jacket_hana, hat_priya, jacket_priya (evenings).
- Table: keys_hana, wallet_hana, keys_priya, wallet_priya, sunglasses_priya (evenings).
- Shoe Rack: shoes_hana, shoes_dana, shoes_priya (evenings).
- Note: Personal items (backpacks, keys, wallets, shoes, jackets, hats, sunglasses, water bottles, phones, pens, notebooks, lunchboxes) are OUT_OF_HOUSE during work hours (Priya/Hana 08:00–17:30; Dana 13:40–23:00). They return to these spots in the evening.

Kitchen:
- Counter: cutting_board_shared, kettle_shared, plant_pot_2_shared, toaster_shared, vitamins_priya, wall_clock_shared, recipe_book_shared (evenings), water_bottle_hana (evenings).
- Cupboard: bowl_hana, duster_shared, glass_dana, glass_hana, glass_priya, mug_hana, pan_shared, plate_dana, plate_hana, plate_priya, pot_shared, snack_bowl_shared.
- Drawer: kitchen_knife_shared, spatula_shared.
- Table: bowl_dana, fruit_bowl_shared.
- Pantry: baking_tray_shared, mixing_bowl_shared, shopping_bag_shared.
- Sink: bowl_priya, mug_dana, mug_priya, serving_dish_shared.
- Dish Rack: water_bottle_priya (evenings).
- Note: Dishes (bowls, mugs, glasses, plates) are washed and put away in the evening.

Living Room:
- Bookshelf: board_game_shared, picture_frame_shared, puzzle_box_shared, speaker_shared, magazine_hana.
- Coffee Table: candle_shared, coasters_shared, magazine_dana, tissue_box_shared
